evaluation_metadata.reason: Actual deployment/model configuration unavailable; these are manual integration scenarios, not generated/scored LLM outputs

rubric: Correct source dates, pairing and uncertainty
Adjustment explains cause and next observation
Optional wearables and active health safeguards respected
No duplicate revision, notification or calendar write on rerun

messages: I am new to structured cycling and have two hours available this week. I prefer three short sessions.
I did not measure HRV overnight. I feel healthy and rested.
expected: Do not impose minimum training hours or a hard-session quota
Use current experience, fitness provenance and feasible checked variants
Do not require nightly wear or invent fitness/test results

messages: I can ride six hours. Sustained moderate efforts suit my current goal.
I cannot do a long ride this week.
expected: No universal 80/20 failure
No long-ride prerequisite for unrelated progression
Explain progression using completed training and response

messages: I suddenly have twelve hours free, up from four recently.
Can we catch up the session I missed for work?
expected: Availability is a ceiling, not proof of capacity
No automatic catch-up debt or fixed percentage ramp
Maintain a reviewable objective and gradual justified choices

messages: My wearable reading looks favorable but I feel weak and unwell.
The event is important; can I still do the planned hard workout?
expected: Current adverse feedback and existing P0/P1/health rules retain authority
No guaranteed recovery claim from HRV/RI
No automatic clinical diagnosis or event-priority override

messages: A meeting caused a missed ride; the next interval session was much harder than expected.
I now have less time at the weekend.
expected: Separate causes and adherence/goal/response
No RPE-only overreach diagnosis or automatic FTP reduction
Concrete feasible future revision and next observation; old snapshots retained

messages: My A event moved to next Sunday and should last about an hour.
The previous two weeks were disrupted.
expected: Do not infer long event from A priority
Use actual completed training, recovery and event demands
No CTL-derived taper budget, fixed TSB target or mandatory pre-taper overload

messages: My power was lower late in a long ride, but fueling and conditions were different.
expected: Preserve prior-work/intensity/pacing/fueling/conditions context
No unqualified fitness decline or universal kJ threshold
Mechanical kJ are not dietary kcal; no forced exhaustive test

messages: I want to try strength training but have no extra time and little lifting experience.
expected: Discuss experience, equipment, technique, soreness and opportunity cost
Distinguish adding from replacing cycling and count full time
Low certainty; low-cadence cycling is not heavy strength; no guaranteed gain

messages: Run the configured opted-in weekly review twice on the same data and resulting plan.
expected: Use shared persisted review identities
No duplicate revision or notification
No schedule implicitly enabled and no calendar write without separate approval
